name: DAFI Protocol
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: According to official sources, DAFI Protocol, an on-chain incentive protocol, stated that DAFI worth 200,000 US dollars was sold due to the “cross-chain asset bridge ChainSwap attack”. DAFI Protocol requests the community to withdraw liquidity from Uniswap and LP plans until further notice. DAFI Protocol added that the DAFI token contract and Super Staking are safe.
